tests.name: Voltage-Gated Potassium Channel Antibodies

analysis.interferences: Approx 20% of patients with VGKC antibodies will have an underlying thymoma. Patients may have Myasthenia gravis with or without acetylcholine receptor antibodies.

clinical.indications: Peripheral nerve hyperexcitability, neuromyotonia, Morvan's syndrome.
